title: Finite biproduct decomposition of the Hom target
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], open U, cochain complexes P,F of module sheaves on U, and integers a,b,n, suppose P^r is zero for r<a or b<r. There is an isomorphism from degree n of Hom(P,F) [def-pur-hom-complex] to the biproduct indexed by a<=r<=b of Hom(P^r,F^(r+n)). Composing this isomorphism with each biproduct projection gives the specified ordinary Hom projection [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. No bound on F is assumed.

proof.text: The recorded Hom projections exhibit a product over all integers. Internal Hom from a zero module sheaf is zero, so all factors outside [a,b] vanish.

Extend any cone on the finite interval by the unique maps into zero factors; lift it to the full product. Projection extensionality proves uniqueness, hence the finite fan is limiting. Identify its finite product with the biproduct to obtain the uniquely specified isomorphism. The empty interval is included.
